news_cards.title: Bihar Mein 51600 Karod Rupye Ka Nivesh Hoga, Steel Hub Banega
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne desh ke pramukh udyogik samuhon ke saath MoU kiya hai, jiske tahat 51600 karod rupye ka nivesh hoga
Is nivesh se Bihar mein steel hub banega, textile aur nuclear energy sector ko bhi badhava milega
Yeh nivesh Bihar Investment Promotion Policy ke tahat kiya ja raha hai, jiska uddeshya rajya mein udyogik vikas ko badhava dena hai

news_cards.title: JP Ganga Path Ko Milega Vishwashtar Roop, 65 Kilometer Ganga Channel Hoga Viksit
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne JP Ganga Path ko vishwashtar roop dena shuru kiya hai, jiske tahat 65 kilometer ganga channel viksit kiya jayega
Is pariyojna se Bihar mein jal parivahan ko badhava milega, aur rajya ki arthik vikas mein vriddhi hogi
Yeh pariyojna Bihar Sarkar ki Saat Nischay-2 yojana ke tahat kiya ja raha hai, jiska uddeshya rajya mein jal parivahan ko sudharana hai

news_cards.title: Bihar Mein Nishulk Steamer Ferry Seva Shuru, Awagaman Hoga Sugam
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne Nasiriganj-Panapar nishulk steamer ferry seva ka shubharabh kiya hai, jisse awagaman hoga sugam
Is seva se Bihar mein jal parivahan ko badhava milega, aur rajya ki arthik vikas mein vriddhi hogi
Yeh seva Bihar Sarkar ki Saat Nischay-2 yojana ke tahat kiya ja raha hai, jiska uddeshya rajya mein jal parivahan ko sudharana hai
